claims.claim_text: Cloudflare 推出「臨時帳號」，專門發給 AI agent 用：一組有範圍、會過期的憑證，讓自主 agent 去操作資源時不必拿長期金鑰。
claims.evidence: "Any agent can now run `wrangler deploy --temporary` and deploy a Worker to Cloudflare." "This temporary deployment stays live for 60 minutes, during which time you can claim the temporary account... If you don't, it expires on its own."

claims.claim_text: 作者算出理論上約 331 人能讓算力和記憶體頻寬打平，但 KV-cache 的容量把實際拉到 40 到 60 人，換算成自有硬體大約每位使用者攤 133 美元。
claims.evidence: "2B = 562 ⟹ B = 331"; "you can serve anywhere between 40-60 users per Blackwell chip"; "serving 300 users per GPU you'll spend a lifetime cost of about $133 per user".

claims.claim_text: 這篇示範 Rust 1.87 之後怎麼用型別系統把「這顆 CPU 支援 AVX2」變成一個無法偽造的證明 token... 作者也把成果做成了 fearless_simd 這個 crate。
claims.evidence: "This changed in Rust 1.87 when the compiler started tracking the required instruction sets itself." `pub struct Avx2(())` gated by `is_x86_feature_detected!("avx2")`. "You can find the production version of these ideas in fearless_simd v0.5..."

claims.claim_text: 一位開發者把 NixOS 的 live 映像從 458MB 一路砍到 183MB... 用 nix why-depends 追出是誰把 144MB 的核心模組和 56MB 的 Perl 依賴拖進來，再換上 system.etc.overlay、services.userborn 這些實驗性選項。
claims.evidence: Starting ISO 458MB reduced to 183MB (~60%). Via `nix why-depends`: 144MB kernel-modules removed; 56MB Perl eliminated using experimental `system.etc.overlay` and `services.userborn`. Author warns against production use.

claims.claim_text: ClickHouse 放出 PostgresBench，用 pgbench 的 TPC-B workload 去比五家代管 Postgres 服務，兩種機型、256 個並發連線各跑十分鐘，報出 throughput 與 P95、P99 延遲。
claims.evidence: TPC-B-like workload across five services; "256 clients with 16 threads"; "10 minutes per test"; reports average TPS, average latency, P95, P99. Two instance sizes: 4 vCPU/16GB and 16 vCPU/64GB. Explicitly a ClickHouse vendor benchmark.

claims.claim_text: Bootimus 是一個自帶電池的網路開機伺服器，把 PXE 與 HTTP boot 兜成一包，省掉自己拼 DHCP、TFTP、HTTP 那串前置設定。
claims.evidence: "Self-contained PXE and HTTP boot server. One binary. Zero config. Built-in proxyDHCP so you never touch your router." "written in Go, with batteries included".

claims.claim_text: ByteByteGo 寫了一篇 observability 的入門，把 logs、metrics、traces 三件事和它們周邊的概念講清楚。
claims.evidence: "Logs, metrics, and traces are three ways of looking at this same stream. A log captures one event... a metric counts or aggregates... a trace links related events as they move across services."

claims.claim_text: Microcrad 把那個極簡的教學用自動微分引擎 micrograd 用 C 重寫了一遍。原版是 Python。
claims.evidence: "microcrad is a tiny scalar-valued automatic differentiation engine for C..." "a re-implementation of Andrej Karpathy's micrograd in C". Repo 95.7% C; original micrograd is Python.

claims.claim_text: Bun 在 JavaScriptCore 的 fork 上開了一個 PR，想替這顆引擎加上共享記憶體的執行緒。
claims.evidence: PR title: "Shared-memory threads for JavaScriptCore (experimental, not working yet)". On oven-sh/WebKit (Bun's fork), behind `--useJSThreads`.

claims.claim_text: 把 HTML 的 UTF-8 位元組逐一映到像素的 RGB 通道——208 位元組的內容只要一張 9×9 的 PNG，瀏覽器載入後用 canvas 把像素讀回來、再解碼成網頁。
claims.evidence: "The payload ended up being 208 bytes"; "The smallest square that works is 9x9 pixels"; UTF-8 bytes mapped to RGB channels; decoder reads pixel data through the canvas API.
